q22662.en: Vehicle S, reversing to join the traffic, must give way to vehicles coming from both the right and the left.

explain.short: S is leaving a parking space in reverse, which is a difficult move. It must let traffic from both directions pass first.
explain.rule: Reversing out of a parking space to join traffic is a risky move: check the road is clear, use the indicator, give way to ALL vehicles from both sides and to pedestrians behind you, and move slowly.
explain.trap: 'sia da destra che da sinistra' (both from right and from left) is correct: S gives way to everyone.

sceneParams.caption: S gives way to traffic from both sides
lines: S reverses out of the parking space
Give way: traffic from right and left

keywords.it: sia da destra che da sinistra
keywords.en: both from the right and from the left

q22663.en: Vehicle S, reversing to join the traffic, must use the direction indicators.

explain.short: S is joining the traffic, so it must tell the others with the indicator, as for any move into the flow.
explain.rule: Reversing out of a parking space to join traffic is a risky move: check the road is clear, use the indicator, give way to ALL vehicles from both sides and to pedestrians behind you, and move slowly.
explain.trap: 'indicatori di direzione' are the indicators (frecce), not the hazard lights.

sceneParams.caption: S signals with the indicator
lines: S reverses out to join traffic

q22664.en: Vehicle S, reversing to join the traffic, must watch out for pedestrians passing behind it and give way to them.

explain.short: When you reverse, people may walk behind the car where you see badly. You must look and let them pass.
explain.rule: Reversing out of a parking space to join traffic is a risky move: check the road is clear, use the indicator, give way to ALL vehicles from both sides and to pedestrians behind you, and move slowly.
explain.trap: 'pedoni in transito dietro di esso' (pedestrians walking behind it) must get priority.

sceneParams.caption: Pedestrians behind S go first
lines: S reverses out of the parking space

q22665.en: Vehicle S, reversing to join the traffic, must give way to all vehicles passing by.

explain.short: A vehicle joining the traffic from a parking space has no priority. All passing vehicles go first.
explain.rule: Reversing out of a parking space to join traffic is a risky move: check the road is clear, use the indicator, give way to ALL vehicles from both sides and to pedestrians behind you, and move slowly.
explain.trap: 'tutti i veicoli' (all vehicles) is right here: nobody must wait for S.

sceneParams.caption: All passing vehicles go first
lines: S reverses out to join traffic

q22666.en: Vehicle S, reversing to join the traffic, must make sure the road is clear and do the manoeuvre with special care.

explain.short: Reversing into traffic is risky because you see less. S starts only when the road is free and moves slowly.
explain.rule: Reversing out of a parking space to join traffic is a risky move: check the road is clear, use the indicator, give way to ALL vehicles from both sides and to pedestrians behind you, and move slowly.
explain.trap: 'particolare prudenza' (special care) is exactly what a reverse manoeuvre needs.

sceneParams.caption: Road clear, slow and careful
lines: S reverses out of the parking space
Check the road is clear, go slowly

q22667.en: Vehicle S, reversing to join the traffic, must switch on the hazard warning lights.

explain.short: Hazard lights are for a stopped vehicle that is a danger, not for joining traffic. S uses the indicator.
explain.rule: Reversing out of a parking space to join traffic is a risky move: check the road is clear, use the indicator, give way to ALL vehicles from both sides and to pedestrians behind you, and move slowly.
explain.trap: 'segnalazione luminosa di pericolo' means the hazard lights (all indicators flashing): wrong signal here.

sceneParams.caption: Use the indicator, not the hazard lights
lines: S reverses out to join traffic

q22668.en: Vehicle S, reversing to join the traffic, must switch on the rear fog light.

explain.short: The rear fog light is only for fog or very poor visibility. It has nothing to do with reversing.
explain.rule: Reversing out of a parking space to join traffic is a risky move: check the road is clear, use the indicator, give way to ALL vehicles from both sides and to pedestrians behind you, and move slowly.
explain.trap: 'luce posteriore per nebbia' (rear fog light) is only for low visibility.

sceneParams.caption: Rear fog light: only in fog
lines: S reverses out to join traffic
Rear fog light: only for fog

q22669.en: Vehicle S, reversing to join the traffic, must give way only to vehicles travelling in its own direction.

explain.short: S must give way to vehicles from BOTH directions, not only to those going its way.
explain.rule: Reversing out of a parking space to join traffic is a risky move: check the road is clear, use the indicator, give way to ALL vehicles from both sides and to pedestrians behind you, and move slowly.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) makes it false: S gives way to everyone.

sceneParams.caption: Give way to both directions, not only one
lines: S reverses out to join traffic
Give way to traffic from both sides

q22670.en: Vehicle S, reversing to join the traffic, must manoeuvre quickly to free the parking space.

explain.short: Reversing into traffic must be done slowly and carefully. Hurrying makes it dangerous.
explain.rule: Reversing out of a parking space to join traffic is a risky move: check the road is clear, use the indicator, give way to ALL vehicles from both sides and to pedestrians behind you, and move slowly.
explain.trap: 'velocemente' (quickly) is wrong: this move needs 'prudenza', not speed.

sceneParams.caption: Reverse slowly, never in a hurry
lines: S reverses out to join traffic

q22671.en: Vehicle S, reversing to join the traffic, must sound the horn repeatedly during the manoeuvre.

explain.short: The horn is only for immediate danger and must be short. Honking all the time is not the way to join traffic.
explain.rule: Reversing out of a parking space to join traffic is a risky move: check the road is clear, use the indicator, give way to ALL vehicles from both sides and to pedestrians behind you, and move slowly.
explain.trap: 'suonare ripetutamente il clacson' (honk again and again) is never required.

sceneParams.caption: No repeated horn: indicator and care
lines: S reverses out to join traffic

q22672.en: It is forbidden, because it is a danger or obstacle to traffic, to keep to the left edge of the carriageway to turn into a road on the right.

explain.short: To turn right you keep close to the RIGHT edge. Staying on the left and then cutting across blocks and endangers others.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to do things that are a danger or an obstacle (intralcio) to traffic: wrong position before a turn, stopping on tram rails, turning without signalling in time, racing, driving too slowly for no reason.
explain.trap: 'margine sinistro' (left edge) with 'svoltare a destra' (turn right): the wrong side.

sceneParams.caption: To turn right, keep to the right edge
lines: Keep close to the right edge

keywords.it: svoltare in una strada a destra
keywords.en: turn into a road on the right

q22673.en: It is forbidden, because it is a danger or obstacle to traffic, to park on tram rails.

explain.short: A car standing on the rails blocks the tram, which cannot steer around it. So it is forbidden.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to do things that are a danger or an obstacle (intralcio) to traffic: wrong position before a turn, stopping on tram rails, turning without signalling in time, racing, driving too slowly for no reason.
explain.trap: 'sostare sui binari tramviari' (parking on tram rails) blocks the tram.

sceneParams.caption: Never stand on tram rails
lines: The tram cannot go around it

q22674.en: It is forbidden, because it is a danger or obstacle to traffic, to change direction without signalling the manoeuvre in good time.

explain.short: Others must know in advance what you will do. A turn signalled late or not at all surprises them.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to do things that are a danger or an obstacle (intralcio) to traffic: wrong position before a turn, stopping on tram rails, turning without signalling in time, racing, driving too slowly for no reason.
explain.trap: 'con sufficiente anticipo' (in good time): signalling at the last moment is not enough.

sceneParams.caption: Signal in good time before turning
lines: No signal or too late: forbidden

q22675.en: It is forbidden, because it is a danger or obstacle to traffic, to race.

explain.short: Racing on public roads puts everyone in danger. It is forbidden.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to do things that are a danger or an obstacle (intralcio) to traffic: wrong position before a turn, stopping on tram rails, turning without signalling in time, racing, driving too slowly for no reason.
explain.trap: 'gareggiare in velocità' means racing against other vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: No racing on public roads
lines: Two cars racing on the road

q22676.en: It is forbidden, because it is a danger or obstacle to traffic, to drive too slowly without a good reason.

explain.short: Driving very slowly for no reason creates queues and risky overtakes. It is an obstacle to traffic.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to do things that are a danger or an obstacle (intralcio) to traffic: wrong position before a turn, stopping on tram rails, turning without signalling in time, racing, driving too slowly for no reason.
explain.trap: 'senza giustificato motivo' (without good reason): slow is fine only with a reason.

sceneParams.caption: Too slow for no reason blocks traffic
lines: Slow only with a good reason

q22677.en: It is forbidden, because it is a danger or obstacle to traffic, to join the flow of traffic coming from side roads.

explain.short: Joining traffic from a side road is normal and allowed. You just give way and signal.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to do things that are a danger or an obstacle (intralcio) to traffic: wrong position before a turn, stopping on tram rails, turning without signalling in time, racing, driving too slowly for no reason.
explain.trap: 'immettersi nel flusso' (join the flow) is a normal move, not a forbidden one.

sceneParams.caption: Joining from a side road is allowed
lines: Car comes from a side road

q22678.en: It is forbidden, because it is a danger or obstacle to traffic, to adjust your speed to the features and conditions of the roads.

explain.short: Adjusting speed to the road is a duty, not a danger. It is what every driver must do.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to do things that are a danger or an obstacle (intralcio) to traffic: wrong position before a turn, stopping on tram rails, turning without signalling in time, racing, driving too slowly for no reason.
explain.trap: 'regolare la velocità' (adjust speed) to the road is required, so it cannot be forbidden.

sceneParams.caption: Adjusting speed to the road is a duty
lines: Road with bends and wet surface
This is a duty, not forbidden

q22679.en: It is forbidden, because it is a danger or obstacle to traffic, to stop a vehicle briefly along the right edge of a one-way carriageway.

explain.short: A short stop at the right edge is the normal place to stop. It is allowed if no sign forbids it.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to do things that are a danger or an obstacle (intralcio) to traffic: wrong position before a turn, stopping on tram rails, turning without signalling in time, racing, driving too slowly for no reason.
explain.trap: 'fermare momentaneamente' (stop briefly) at the 'margine destro' (right edge) is the correct way.

sceneParams.caption: A brief stop at the right edge is allowed
lines: Brief stop at the right edge

q22680.en: A driver, even of a high-performance vehicle, must never exceed the speed limits set by law.

explain.short: Speed limits are the same for everyone. A powerful car does not give you any extra right.
explain.rule: Every driver, even with a powerful car, must respect speed limits, give way to the right as a rule, keep to the right, check the mirror before signalling a lane change and not be a danger to others.
explain.trap: 'anche se ad elevate prestazioni' (even if high-performance) changes nothing.

sceneParams.caption: Powerful car, same speed limits

q22681.en: A driver, even of a high-performance vehicle, must as a rule give way at crossroads to all vehicles coming from the right.

explain.short: The basic rule at a junction without signs is: give way to the right. It applies to everyone.
explain.rule: Every driver, even with a powerful car, must respect speed limits, give way to the right as a rule, keep to the right, check the mirror before signalling a lane change and not be a danger to others.
explain.trap: 'di norma' (as a rule) is correct: signs or lights can change it.

sceneParams.caption: At a junction: give way to the right
lines: Car coming from the right goes first

q22682.en: A driver, even of a high-performance vehicle, must avoid being a danger to other road users.

explain.short: Every driver must drive so as not to put others at risk. This is the basic rule of the road.
explain.rule: Every driver, even with a powerful car, must respect speed limits, give way to the right as a rule, keep to the right, check the mirror before signalling a lane change and not be a danger to others.
explain.trap: 'evitare di costituire pericolo' (avoid being a danger) is a duty for all.

sceneParams.caption: Never be a danger to others

q22683.en: A driver, even of a high-performance vehicle, must look in the rear-view mirror before signalling the intention to change lane.

explain.short: First look in the mirror, then use the indicator, then change lane. The mirror comes first.
explain.rule: Every driver, even with a powerful car, must respect speed limits, give way to the right as a rule, keep to the right, check the mirror before signalling a lane change and not be a danger to others.
explain.trap: 'prima di segnalare' (before signalling): mirror first, indicator second.

sceneParams.caption: Mirror first, then the indicator

q22684.en: A driver, even of a high-performance vehicle, must keep as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway when turning right.

explain.short: To turn right you stay close to the right edge, so others can pass on your left and you take a tight turn.
explain.rule: Every driver, even with a powerful car, must respect speed limits, give way to the right as a rule, keep to the right, check the mirror before signalling a lane change and not be a danger to others.
explain.trap: 'margine destro' (right edge) with 'svolta a destra' (right turn): the correct side.

sceneParams.caption: Turning right: keep close to the right edge
lines: Keep close to the right edge

q22685.en: A driver must always drive in the middle of the road, but without crossing the lane line.

explain.short: In Italy you keep to the RIGHT side of the road, not the middle.
explain.rule: Every driver, even with a powerful car, must respect speed limits, give way to the right as a rule, keep to the right, check the mirror before signalling a lane change and not be a danger to others.
explain.trap: 'sempre al centro della strada' (always in the middle) is wrong: keep right.

sceneParams.caption: Keep to the right, not the middle

keywords.en: in the middle of the road

q22686.en: A driver must keep the high beams on during the day, even in town.

explain.short: High beams dazzle others and are not for daytime in town. By day you use dipped beams (on many roads they are compulsory).
explain.rule: Every driver, even with a powerful car, must respect speed limits, give way to the right as a rule, keep to the right, check the mirror before signalling a lane change and not be a danger to others.
explain.trap: 'abbaglianti' (high beams) are not for day or town traffic.

sceneParams.caption: No high beams by day in town

q22687.en: A driver may overtake in any traffic condition, as long as there is no no-overtaking sign.

explain.short: Even without a sign, you may overtake only when it is safe: good view, free road, nobody overtaking you.
explain.rule: Every driver, even with a powerful car, must respect speed limits, give way to the right as a rule, keep to the right, check the mirror before signalling a lane change and not be a danger to others.
explain.trap: 'in ogni condizione di traffico' (in any traffic condition) is wrong: traffic can make it unsafe.

sceneParams.caption: No sign, but oncoming traffic: no overtaking

q22688.en: A driver must use the horn in towns every time they approach a cycle crossing.

explain.short: In towns the horn is allowed only in case of immediate danger. At a cycle crossing you slow down and look.
explain.rule: Every driver, even with a powerful car, must respect speed limits, give way to the right as a rule, keep to the right, check the mirror before signalling a lane change and not be a danger to others.
explain.trap: 'ogni qualvolta' (every time) is wrong: the horn is only for real danger.

sceneParams.caption: At cycle crossings: slow down, no horn

q22689.en: A driver may fit two-tone horns to be heard more easily, but use them only outside towns.

explain.short: Two-tone horns are for emergency vehicles like ambulances and police. Private cars may not fit them.
explain.rule: Every driver, even with a powerful car, must respect speed limits, give way to the right as a rule, keep to the right, check the mirror before signalling a lane change and not be a danger to others.
explain.trap: 'trombe bitonali' (two-tone horns) are forbidden on normal cars, in or out of town.

sceneParams.caption: Two-tone horns: only emergency vehicles
lines: Two-tone horn on a private car

q22690.en: On motorcycles you may carry animals if they are kept in a suitable cage.

explain.short: A motorcycle may carry an animal only inside a proper cage or box, so it cannot move or fall.
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'se custoditi in apposita gabbia' (if kept in a suitable cage) is the condition.

sceneParams.caption: Animals on a motorcycle: only in a cage

q22691.en: On motorcycles the load must be placed so that it does not stick out more than 50 cm to the side.

explain.short: On a motorcycle a load may stick out sideways, but not more than 50 cm, so it stays balanced and does not hit others.
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'oltre 50 cm' (more than 50 cm) is the real limit for motorcycles.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycle load: max 50 cm to the side

q22692.en: On cars the load must be placed so that it does not reduce the driver's view.

explain.short: If the load blocks the windows or mirrors, you cannot see the road and traffic. That is dangerous.
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'visibilità del conducente' (driver's view) must stay free.

sceneParams.caption: Load must not block your view

q22693.en: On cars the load must be placed so that it does not limit freedom of movement while driving.

explain.short: You must be able to steer, brake and change gear freely. The load must not get in the way.
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'libertà di movimenti' (freedom of movement) for driving must be kept.

sceneParams.caption: Load must not block your movements

q22694.en: On cars the load must be placed so that it cannot fall.

explain.short: A falling load is a big danger for the vehicles behind. It must be tied and secured.
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'evitarne la caduta' (prevent it from falling) is a basic duty.

sceneParams.caption: Secure the load so it cannot fall
lines: Car with a load on the roof
Tie it so it cannot fall

q22695.en: On cars the load must be placed so that it does not stick out at the back by more than three tenths of the vehicle's length.

explain.short: At the back a load may stick out, but at most 3/10 of the vehicle length.
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'parte posteriore' (back) and 'tre decimi' (3/10): this is the real rear limit.

sceneParams.caption: Rear overhang: max 3/10 of the length
lines: Only at the back, max 3/10 length

q22696.en: The load on cars must not exceed the payload shown in the registration document.

explain.short: The registration document (carta di circolazione) states the maximum load. You must not go over it.
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'portata' (payload) is the maximum weight the vehicle may carry.

sceneParams.caption: Never over the payload in the document
lines: Weight within the payload in the document

q22697.en: On cars the load must be placed so that it does not stick out sideways by more than three tenths of the vehicle's length.

explain.short: The 3/10 rule is for the BACK. At the sides the load must not stick out beyond the vehicle.
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'sporgenza laterale' (sideways) is the trap: 3/10 is only for the rear.

sceneParams.caption: 3/10 is for the back, not the sides

q22698.en: On cars the load must be placed so that it is not more than 10% above the maximum height in the registration document, but within 4 metres.

explain.short: There is no '10% extra' for height. The load must stay within the allowed height (normally 4 m).
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'oltre il 10%' (more than 10%) is invented: no extra percentage is allowed.

sceneParams.caption: No 10% extra height allowed

q22699.en: On cars the load must be placed so that it is not more than 10% above the payload shown in the registration document.

explain.short: You may not exceed the payload at all. There is no 10% margin.
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'oltre il 10%' (more than 10%) suggests a margin that does not exist.

sceneParams.caption: No 10% extra weight: stay within payload

q22700.en: On cars the load must be placed so that it sticks out at the front of the vehicle by more than three tenths of its length.

explain.short: The load must not stick out at the front. Only the back allows up to 3/10.
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'parte anteriore' (front) is the trap: 3/10 is for the back.

sceneParams.caption: Front overhang: not allowed
lines: Load sticking out at the front

q22701.en: By day, a load sticking out at the back must be marked with a red cloth.

explain.short: A rear overhang is marked with a special square reflective panel with red and white stripes, not a red cloth.
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'panno rosso' (red cloth) is not the legal signal.

sceneParams.caption: Use the red-white striped panel, not a cloth
lines: Load sticking out at the back

q22702.en: A rear overhang of the load must be marked with a reflective panel with yellow and red stripes.

explain.short: The panel for a rear overhang has red and WHITE stripes, not yellow and red.
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'strisce gialle e rosse' (yellow and red stripes) is the wrong colour.

sceneParams.caption: The panel is red and white, not yellow
lines: Load sticking out at the back

q22703.en: On motorcycles you may never carry a load.

explain.short: Motorcycles may carry a load if it is well secured and within the limits (e.g. max 50 cm to the side).
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'in nessun caso' (in no case) is too absolute.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycles may carry a secured load

q22704.en: On motorcycles you may carry shopping bags even if they are not firmly secured.

explain.short: Any load on a motorcycle must be well secured. Loose bags can fall or upset your balance.
explain.rule: Load on a car must not block your view or your movements, must not fall, must not exceed the payload and may stick out only at the back, up to 3/10 of the vehicle length, marked with a red-and-white striped panel. On motorcycles: max 50 cm to the side, animals only in a cage, load well secured.
explain.trap: 'anche se non saldamente assicurati' (even if not firmly secured) makes it false.

sceneParams.caption: Bags on a motorcycle must be secured

q22705.en: Correct use of the road means vehicles move at a speed suited to the road and traffic conditions.

explain.short: Your speed must fit the road, the weather and the traffic, not only the speed limit.
explain.rule: Correct use of the road means: speed suited to road and traffic, prudence, give way to pedestrians on crossings, right lights for the situation, mirrors before the indicator. It does not mean 'always', 'in every case' or 'as fast as possible'.
explain.trap: 'velocità adeguata' (suitable speed) is the key idea.

sceneParams.caption: Speed suited to road and traffic
lines: Speed suited to road and traffic

keywords.it: condizioni della strada e del traffico

q22706.en: Correct use of the road means following the rules of behaviour and those of common prudence.

explain.short: You follow the traffic rules and also use common sense and care in every situation.
explain.rule: Correct use of the road means: speed suited to road and traffic, prudence, give way to pedestrians on crossings, right lights for the situation, mirrors before the indicator. It does not mean 'always', 'in every case' or 'as fast as possible'.
explain.trap: 'comune prudenza' (common prudence) is part of the rules too.

sceneParams.caption: Rules plus common sense

q22707.en: Correct use of the road means hurrying to clear the junction when the traffic light shows a steady yellow and you cannot stop safely before the stop line.

explain.short: Steady yellow means stop, unless you are too close to stop safely. Then you clear the junction quickly.
explain.rule: Correct use of the road means: speed suited to road and traffic, prudence, give way to pedestrians on crossings, right lights for the situation, mirrors before the indicator. It does not mean 'always', 'in every case' or 'as fast as possible'.
explain.trap: 'non si è in grado di arrestare il veicolo in sicurezza' (cannot stop safely) is the key condition.

sceneParams.caption: Too close to stop on yellow: clear the junction
lines: Steady yellow, too close to stop

q22708.en: Correct use of the road means giving way to pedestrians crossing on pedestrian crossings.

explain.short: On a zebra crossing pedestrians have priority. You stop and let them cross.
explain.rule: Correct use of the road means: speed suited to road and traffic, prudence, give way to pedestrians on crossings, right lights for the situation, mirrors before the indicator. It does not mean 'always', 'in every case' or 'as fast as possible'.
explain.trap: 'attraversamenti pedonali' (pedestrian crossings): pedestrians on them go first.

sceneParams.caption: Pedestrians on the crossing go first

q22709.en: Correct use of the road means using dipped headlights in built-up areas at night.

explain.short: In towns at night the streets are lit and there is traffic. Dipped beams light the road without dazzling others.
explain.rule: Correct use of the road means: speed suited to road and traffic, prudence, give way to pedestrians on crossings, right lights for the situation, mirrors before the indicator. It does not mean 'always', 'in every case' or 'as fast as possible'.
explain.trap: 'anabbaglianti' (dipped beams), not 'abbaglianti' (high beams).

sceneParams.caption: At night in town: dipped beams

q22710.en: Correct use of the road means looking in the rear-view mirrors before switching on the indicator to change lane.

explain.short: Before signalling a lane change you check the mirrors, to see who is coming behind.
explain.rule: Correct use of the road means: speed suited to road and traffic, prudence, give way to pedestrians on crossings, right lights for the situation, mirrors before the indicator. It does not mean 'always', 'in every case' or 'as fast as possible'.
explain.trap: 'prima di azionare l'indicatore' (before switching on the indicator): mirror first.

sceneParams.caption: Mirrors first, then the indicator

q22711.en: Correct use of the road means vehicles always enter the carriageway as quickly as possible.

explain.short: You enter the road when it is safe, giving way and with care, not as fast as possible.
explain.rule: Correct use of the road means: speed suited to road and traffic, prudence, give way to pedestrians on crossings, right lights for the situation, mirrors before the indicator. It does not mean 'always', 'in every case' or 'as fast as possible'.
explain.trap: 'sempre' and 'il più rapidamente possibile' (always, as fast as possible) make it false.

sceneParams.caption: Join when safe, not as fast as possible

q22712.en: Correct use of the road means always stopping at pedestrian crossings and moving off only if no pedestrians are coming.

explain.short: You give way to pedestrians who are crossing or about to cross. With nobody there, you do not have to stop.
explain.rule: Correct use of the road means: speed suited to road and traffic, prudence, give way to pedestrians on crossings, right lights for the situation, mirrors before the indicator. It does not mean 'always', 'in every case' or 'as fast as possible'.
explain.trap: 'sempre' (always) is too much: you stop only when pedestrians need to cross.

sceneParams.caption: Stop only if pedestrians are crossing
lines: No need to stop every time

q22713.en: Correct use of the road means using high beams in every case.

explain.short: High beams dazzle others. You use them only outside towns at night when nobody is coming.
explain.rule: Correct use of the road means: speed suited to road and traffic, prudence, give way to pedestrians on crossings, right lights for the situation, mirrors before the indicator. It does not mean 'always', 'in every case' or 'as fast as possible'.
explain.trap: 'in ogni caso' (in every case) makes it false.

sceneParams.caption: High beams only when nobody is dazzled
lines: High beams in every case: wrong

q22714.en: Correct use of the road means always stopping when you see the sign in the picture.

explain.short: The sign is GIVE WAY (dare precedenza). You slow down and stop only if traffic is coming.
explain.rule: Correct use of the road means: speed suited to road and traffic, prudence, give way to pedestrians on crossings, right lights for the situation, mirrors before the indicator. It does not mean 'always', 'in every case' or 'as fast as possible'.
explain.trap: 'in ogni caso' (in every case) is for STOP, not for this give-way triangle.

sceneParams.caption: Give way: slow down, stop only if needed

q22715.en: Correct use of the road means driving at high speed so as not to get in the way.

explain.short: Speed must suit the road and traffic. Driving fast to avoid being in the way is dangerous.
explain.rule: Correct use of the road means: speed suited to road and traffic, prudence, give way to pedestrians on crossings, right lights for the situation, mirrors before the indicator. It does not mean 'always', 'in every case' or 'as fast as possible'.
explain.trap: 'velocità elevata' (high speed) is never the rule.

sceneParams.caption: Drive at a suitable speed, not fast
lines: Speed suited to road and traffic

q22716.en: When, near a junction, we notice we are in the wrong turning lane, we must follow the direction allowed by any road markings.

explain.short: Your lane's arrows tell you where to go. Follow them, even if it is not the way you wanted.
explain.rule: If you are in the wrong turning lane (corsia di preselezione) near a junction, do not change lane, do not stop or reverse: go in the direction your lane allows, giving way as required, and find another way later.
explain.trap: 'segnaletica orizzontale' (road markings) are the arrows on the road: follow them.

sceneParams.caption: Follow your lane's arrows
lines: You are in the wrong lane

q22717.en: When, near a junction, we notice we are in the wrong turning lane, we must not change lane, also so as not to obstruct the vehicles behind.

explain.short: Changing lane at the last moment surprises and blocks others. Stay in your lane.
explain.rule: If you are in the wrong turning lane (corsia di preselezione) near a junction, do not change lane, do not stop or reverse: go in the direction your lane allows, giving way as required, and find another way later.
explain.trap: 'non dobbiamo effettuare cambiamenti di corsia' (we must not change lane) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Do not change lane at the last moment

q22718.en: When, near a junction, we notice we are in the wrong turning lane, we must not stop suddenly, to avoid rear-end crashes and confusion in traffic.

explain.short: Braking hard can make the car behind crash into you. Keep moving normally in your lane.
explain.rule: If you are in the wrong turning lane (corsia di preselezione) near a junction, do not change lane, do not stop or reverse: go in the direction your lane allows, giving way as required, and find another way later.
explain.trap: 'arrestare bruscamente' (stop suddenly) is what you must NOT do.

sceneParams.caption: Do not brake suddenly

q22719.en: When, near a junction, we notice we are in the wrong turning lane, we must not stop to ask for information, so as not to hold up the traffic flow.

explain.short: Stopping in the lane to ask the way blocks everyone behind. Go on and ask later.
explain.rule: If you are in the wrong turning lane (corsia di preselezione) near a junction, do not change lane, do not stop or reverse: go in the direction your lane allows, giving way as required, and find another way later.
explain.trap: 'non ci dobbiamo fermare' (we must not stop) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Do not stop to ask the way

q22720.en: When, near a junction, we notice we are in the wrong turning lane, we must go in the direction required by the signs, giving way as required.

explain.short: You go where the signs and markings of your lane say, and give way to whoever has priority.
explain.rule: If you are in the wrong turning lane (corsia di preselezione) near a junction, do not change lane, do not stop or reverse: go in the direction your lane allows, giving way as required, and find another way later.
explain.trap: 'nel senso voluto dalla segnaletica' (the direction required by the signs) is the right choice.

sceneParams.caption: Go where the signs say, giving way
lines: Go where your lane's signs say

q22721.en: Coming to a junction, if you cannot understand at once who has priority, you must go on with prudence and care.

explain.short: If the situation is not clear, slow down, look well and go on carefully.
explain.rule: If you are in the wrong turning lane (corsia di preselezione) near a junction, do not change lane, do not stop or reverse: go in the direction your lane allows, giving way as required, and find another way later.
explain.trap: 'con prudenza e accortezza' (with prudence and care) is the safe answer.

sceneParams.caption: Priority unclear: slow down, go carefully

q22722.en: Coming to a junction, if you cannot understand at once who has priority, you may go on without slowing down if you choose to go straight on.

explain.short: Going straight does not give you priority. If it is unclear, you must slow down.
explain.rule: If you are in the wrong turning lane (corsia di preselezione) near a junction, do not change lane, do not stop or reverse: go in the direction your lane allows, giving way as required, and find another way later.
explain.trap: 'senza rallentare' (without slowing down) is wrong in an unclear situation.

sceneParams.caption: Going straight: still slow down

q22723.en: When, near a junction, we notice we are in the wrong turning lane, we must make the turn we intended, but giving way to all vehicles.

explain.short: You must follow your lane's direction, not the turn you wanted. Turning from the wrong lane cuts across others.
explain.rule: If you are in the wrong turning lane (corsia di preselezione) near a junction, do not change lane, do not stop or reverse: go in the direction your lane allows, giving way as required, and find another way later.
explain.trap: 'la manovra di svolta che intendevamo fare' (the turn we intended) is the wrong choice.

sceneParams.caption: Do not turn from the wrong lane
lines: Turning from the wrong lane: no

q22724.en: When, near a junction, we notice we are in the wrong turning lane, we must ask the traffic police for advice.

explain.short: Stopping to ask the police blocks traffic. Just follow your lane's direction.
explain.rule: If you are in the wrong turning lane (corsia di preselezione) near a junction, do not change lane, do not stop or reverse: go in the direction your lane allows, giving way as required, and find another way later.
explain.trap: 'chiedere consiglio' (ask for advice) means stopping: not required, and it blocks others.

sceneParams.caption: No need to ask the police: follow the lane

q22725.en: When, near a junction, we notice we are in the wrong turning lane, we must switch on all the indicators at once as a danger signal.

explain.short: Being in the wrong lane is not an emergency. Hazard lights are not used; you just follow your lane.
explain.rule: If you are in the wrong turning lane (corsia di preselezione) near a junction, do not change lane, do not stop or reverse: go in the direction your lane allows, giving way as required, and find another way later.
explain.trap: 'accensione simultanea di tutti gli indicatori' means hazard lights: wrong here.

sceneParams.caption: No hazard lights: just follow your lane

keywords.it: accensione simultanea di tutti gli indicatori

q22726.en: When, near a junction, we notice we are in the wrong turning lane, we must pull over to the right and stop until the line of vehicles behind has passed.

explain.short: Stopping blocks the traffic and is dangerous. You simply go where your lane goes.
explain.rule: If you are in the wrong turning lane (corsia di preselezione) near a junction, do not change lane, do not stop or reverse: go in the direction your lane allows, giving way as required, and find another way later.
explain.trap: 'fermarci finché non sia passata la colonna' (stop until the queue passes) is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Do not stop: go where your lane goes

q22727.en: When, near a junction, we notice we are in the wrong turning lane, we try to reverse carefully to the point where the solid lane lines end.

explain.short: Reversing in traffic near a junction is very dangerous and not allowed here. Go on in your lane.
explain.rule: If you are in the wrong turning lane (corsia di preselezione) near a junction, do not change lane, do not stop or reverse: go in the direction your lane allows, giving way as required, and find another way later.
explain.trap: 'retrocedere' (go backwards) is never the solution, even 'con prudenza'.

sceneParams.caption: Never reverse in a turning lane

q22728.en: When, near a junction, we notice we are in the wrong turning lane, we must get to the traffic light and wait for the light to let us change lane.

explain.short: No traffic light lets you change lane at the junction. You go where your lane goes.
explain.rule: If you are in the wrong turning lane (corsia di preselezione) near a junction, do not change lane, do not stop or reverse: go in the direction your lane allows, giving way as required, and find another way later.
explain.trap: 'cambio di corsia' at the light is still a forbidden lane change.

sceneParams.caption: No lane change at the light either
lines: Changing lane at the light: no

q22729.en: In a built-up area, when a pedestrian outside the zebra crossing does not seem to give way to us, we must reduce speed and, if needed, stop so as not to hit them.

explain.short: Even outside the crossing, the pedestrian's safety comes first. Slow down and stop if needed.
explain.rule: In a town, if a pedestrian crossing outside the zebra crossing does not give way to you, slow down and stop if needed. Use a short horn only for immediate danger. Never just carry on.
explain.trap: 'ridurre la velocità e, occorrendo, fermarsi' (slow down and, if needed, stop) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down, stop if needed

q22730.en: In a built-up area, when a pedestrian outside the zebra crossing does not seem to give way to us, it is advisable to slow down and warn them with a short horn, in case of immediate danger.

explain.short: In towns a short horn is allowed for immediate danger. Together with slowing down, it can warn the pedestrian.
explain.rule: In a town, if a pedestrian crossing outside the zebra crossing does not give way to you, slow down and stop if needed. Use a short horn only for immediate danger. Never just carry on.
explain.trap: 'breve colpo di clacson, in caso di pericolo immediato' (short horn only for immediate danger) is the legal use.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down; short horn only for real danger
lines: Short horn only if danger is immediate

q22731.en: In a built-up area, when a pedestrian outside the zebra crossing does not seem to give way to us, we must reduce speed until we stop in time, if needed.

explain.short: You slow down and, if the pedestrian keeps crossing, you stop in time.
explain.rule: In a town, if a pedestrian crossing outside the zebra crossing does not give way to you, slow down and stop if needed. Use a short horn only for immediate danger. Never just carry on.
explain.trap: 'fermarsi tempestivamente' (stop in time) is the right reaction.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down and stop in time

q22732.en: In a built-up area, when a pedestrian outside the zebra crossing does not seem to give way to us, it is advisable at night to drive with high beams on so that they notice us.

explain.short: High beams dazzle the pedestrian, who may then see even less. You slow down instead.
explain.rule: In a town, if a pedestrian crossing outside the zebra crossing does not give way to you, slow down and stop if needed. Use a short horn only for immediate danger. Never just carry on.
explain.trap: 'abbaglianti accesi' (high beams on) dazzle: wrong in town with a pedestrian.

sceneParams.caption: No high beams: they dazzle the pedestrian
lines: Pedestrian crossing at night in town

q22733.en: In a built-up area, when a pedestrian outside the zebra crossing does not seem to give way to us, it is advisable to try to get their attention by any means so that they give way to us.

explain.short: The goal is not to make the pedestrian give way. You slow down and let them cross safely.
explain.rule: In a town, if a pedestrian crossing outside the zebra crossing does not give way to you, slow down and stop if needed. Use a short horn only for immediate danger. Never just carry on.
explain.trap: 'con qualsiasi mezzo' (by any means) and 'perché ci dia la precedenza' (so they give way) are both wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Do not force them: slow down instead

keywords.en: so that they give way to us

q22734.en: In a built-up area, when a pedestrian outside the zebra crossing does not seem to give way to us, we must carry on without caring about them, because we have priority.

explain.short: Even if you have priority, you must never hit a pedestrian. Slow down and stop if needed.
explain.rule: In a town, if a pedestrian crossing outside the zebra crossing does not give way to you, slow down and stop if needed. Use a short horn only for immediate danger. Never just carry on.
explain.trap: 'senza curarci di lui' (without caring about him) is never allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Never ignore a pedestrian, even with priority
